ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Kalyx uses Face ID to unlock your wallet and confirm your sensitive operations.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Kalyx uses the camera to scan QR codes: payment addresses and WalletConnect connections.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Kalyx opens a photo you choose to read a payment QR code from it. No other image is read.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Kalyx never records audio; this permission is never requested.
